title: The Paradox of Robustness: Decoupling Rule-Based Logic from Affective Noise in High-Stakes Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: A controlled perturbation framework that compares LLM outputs on structured, rule-bound decision-making tasks (across healthcare, law, and finance) when presented with emotionally-charged, procedurally-irrelevant narratives versus length-matched affectively-neutral narratives.
